brief: Saudi Arabia: Cenomi Centers' chief executive says Westfield Riyadh, about 95% pre-leased with its structural works complete, is on target to start operating in Q4 2026, while Westfield Jeddah, close to 97% pre-leased, still has no grand-opening date (Argaam, 12 Nov).
Members in Kuwait: Mabanee says Aventura Mall is built and will open in November, and it is preparing to open The Avenues Riyadh on 27 March 2027 (Al-Anba, 11 Nov).

Events and loyalty: the FII Institute has set 25 to 28 October 2027 for the postponed FII10 in Riyadh (Arabian Business, 12 Nov), and Majid Al Futtaim's SHARE now lets members in the UAE and Saudi Arabia book Expedia travel for up to 4% back in points (Majid Al Futtaim, 12 Nov).

Customer data: Landmark Group has alerted some Shukran members after unauthorised access to names, contact details and dates of birth, and says cards, passwords and points were not affected (Gulf News, 11 Nov).

Directory checks: a card titled 'Upcoming 12 downtown mix use projects' is a placeholder for Saudi Downtown Company's programme, Golden Gate in New Cairo appears twice, Madinah Gate's printed March 2024 opening has passed, The Point in Abha was launched with 50,000 sqm of leasing area, and 'Al Shubily Mall' is Al Shubaily Grand Mall in Al Khobar.
weekly_brief: Week 46 (9 to 13 November): 40 findings and 8 library documents across five editions, with Friday's checks of directory listings.

Saudi Arabia: Cenomi Centers' Q3 profit fell 19% to SAR 404.9m against a year-earlier insurance gain as revenue rose 10% to SAR 606.2m, and its chief executive kept Westfield Riyadh on target to start operating in Q4 2026; Knowledge Economic City's Q3 profit rose to SAR 99.7m; Makkah Construction took a 25-year lease on Al Misfalah Park for a commercial and leisure destination; Al-Andalus Mall's expansion in Jeddah is fully leased; and the FII Institute set 25 to 28 October 2027 for the postponed FII10.
Kuwait and Riyadh: Mabanee says Aventura Mall is built and will open in November, and that it is preparing to open The Avenues Riyadh on 27 March 2027.

UAE: CBRE put Q3 mall occupancy at 97% in Dubai and 96% in Abu Dhabi, with about 240,000 sqm of retail GLA due in 2027, while JLL reported Dubai's new retail leases down 7.3% year on year; Lulu Retail's Q3 revenue rose 2% to $1.9bn as online sales jumped 53%; Nakheel unveiled Palm Springs next to Palm Jebel Ali; the Dubai Shopping Festival announced its opening programme; and DEAL Holdings' FAB Group plans at least 25 UAE food and beverage sites.

Loyalty and service: Majid Al Futtaim's SHARE added conversions with Emirates Skywards and travel bookings with Expedia; Landmark Group alerted some Shukran members to unauthorised access to personal data; Amazon.ae became the first online retailer on the UAE's Essential Goods Prices Platform; Egypt's central bank set rules for banks' agents; and Saudi health bodies won 36 awards at the International Customer Experience Awards.

AI and retail technology: OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT with product feeds and Business Agents; Zalando launched an agent that buys from other retailers inside its app; CrediMax and Mastercard will explore AI shopping agents for Bahrain's merchants; etisalat by e& started selling Meta's AI glasses; and Creators HQ and YouTube will train more than 1,000 creators to sell through YouTube Shopping.

Tenants and formats: JYSK opened its 18th Türkiye store at Mall of İstanbul, U.S. Polo Assn. opened a concept store at Koru Florya, Elya Center AVM in Ankara started leasing, the world's first KFC Muse opened at JBR in Dubai, and Korea Town by Boutiqaat opened two stores in Qatar.

Directory checks: Friday's checks found a placeholder card for Saudi Downtown Company's 12 projects, two cards for Golden Gate in New Cairo, a passed 2024 opening for Madinah Gate, a larger leasing area for The Point in Abha, and Al Shubaily Grand Mall listed under another spelling.

findings.title: Cenomi keeps Westfield Riyadh on target to start operating in Q4 2026, while Westfield Jeddah's grand opening is still undated
findings.summary: In an interview Argaam published on 12 Nov, Cenomi Centers chief executive Alison Rehill-Erguven said Westfield Riyadh's structural works are complete, pre-leasing has approached 95% and the mall is targeted to enter its operational phase in Q4 2026. Westfield Jeddah, in its operational phase since July 2026, generated SAR 20.4 million of revenue in Q3 and is close to 97% pre-leased, but she gave no grand-opening date, saying the focus is on completing tenant fit-outs and opening stores and that pre-leasing does not necessarily reflect the occupancy of stores already trading. Footfall across the portfolio rose 20.7% to 39 million visitors in Q3 and like-for-like occupancy was 91.8%; these figures agree with Mubasher's 9 Nov copy of Cenomi's Q3 disclosure.
findings.why: Two of the largest malls in the Saudi pipeline: Riyadh's Q4 2026 target still holds seven weeks before year-end, while Jeddah's grand opening, guided for Q4 2026, has no date yet.

sources.outlet: Mubasher (copy of the Saudi Exchange disclosure)

findings.title: FII Institute sets 25 to 28 October 2027 for the postponed FII10 in Riyadh
findings.summary: The FII Institute said on 12 Nov that the 10th Future Investment Initiative will take place in Riyadh from 25 to 28 October 2027, a year after its original dates of 26 to 29 October 2026, with the theme 'The Power of Legacy'. The institute said the new timing is intended to secure the highest level of international participation and gave no further reasons for the postponement. The FII PRIORITY Miami Summit stays on 31 March to 2 April 2027, and an FII PRIORITY Asia Summit is planned for 2027, with dates and location still to come.
findings.why: A firm date for one of the Riyadh events moved into 2027 since October, alongside the Saudi Retail Forum and Intersec Saudi Arabia, for MECSR's events calendar.

findings.entity: Hyper Panda property, Al Hamdaniyah district
findings.title: SEDCO Capital REIT Fund agrees to sell its Hyper Panda property in Al Hamdaniyah, Jeddah
findings.summary: The board of SEDCO Capital REIT Fund approved on 12 Nov the signing of an agreement to sell the fund's Hyper Panda property in Jeddah's Al Hamdaniyah district, which it bought in April 2018, Argaam reported. The buyer is not named and the sale is subject to completion; the fund manager said it may use part of the proceeds to repay existing bank facilities. The price and the expected gain, reported by Argaam alone, wait for a second source.
findings.why: A listed Saudi REIT is selling a standalone hypermarket asset in Jeddah, a reference point for the value of grocery-anchored retail property in the Kingdom.

findings.title: Majid Al Futtaim's SHARE adds Expedia travel bookings for members in the UAE and Saudi Arabia
findings.summary: SHARE members in the UAE and Saudi Arabia can now book hotels, flights and holiday packages with Expedia inside the SHARE app, earning 4% back in SHARE points on hotels, 3% on packages and 1% on flights, Majid Al Futtaim said in a release dated 12 Nov. The company says SHARE connects more than 16 million members to more than 7,000 stores in five markets: the UAE, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Oman and Kenya. It is the third extension of SHARE in a week, after Carrefour Kenya (5 Nov) and the Emirates Skywards link (10 Nov).
findings.why: A mall and grocery group is using travel partners to keep loyalty members earning inside its own programme, a live case for MECSC's loyalty and CX content.

findings.title: Mabanee says Aventura Mall is built and will open in November
findings.summary: Construction of Aventura Mall in Kuwait is 100% complete and Mabanee is preparing to open it during November 2026, Al-Anba reported on 11 Nov from the company's Q3 2026 analyst and investor conference. Mabanee had guided to the end of October on 29 July, and no opening day has been published. Its 2025 annual report gives the mall a total leasable area of 108,297 sqm, and Alshaya has said Primark's second Kuwait store opens there early in 2027.
findings.why: The next large mall opening in Kuwait, from a member, and a 2027 Directory entry that still needs its opening day.

findings.title: Mabanee is preparing to open The Avenues Riyadh on 27 March 2027
findings.summary: Mabanee is preparing to open The Avenues Riyadh on 27 March 2027, Al-Anba reported on 11 Nov from the company's Q3 2026 analyst and investor conference. The date falls within Mabanee's Q1 2027 guidance and fits Alshaya's plan to open Primark's first Saudi store there in March 2027. The same report says The Avenues Khobar is progressing to plan but gives it no opening date; the leasing and completion percentages it quotes rest on this one report and wait on the watch list.
findings.why: A firm opening day for one of the largest malls in the Riyadh pipeline, for the 2027 Directory and for Saudi membership and events planning.

findings.title: Landmark Group alerts some Shukran members after unauthorised access to customer information
findings.summary: Landmark Group messaged some members of its Shukran loyalty programme on WhatsApp late on Tuesday 10 Nov after identifying unauthorised access to some of their personal information, including names, contact details and dates of birth, Gulf News reported on 11 Nov. The company says payment card details and passwords were not affected, nor were Shukran points, balances and wallets, and that it acted immediately to contain the incident, launched an investigation, informed the relevant regulatory and law enforcement authorities and contacted affected customers directly. It has not said how many members or which markets are affected. Members were told to be wary of unexpected calls and messages; Shukran says it asks for one-time passwords only at its store counters or in the Shukran app.
findings.why: A data incident at one of the region's largest retail loyalty programmes, and a live case of breach communication for MECSC's customer-service and loyalty members.

findings.title: Creators HQ and YouTube will train more than 1,000 creators to sell through YouTube Shopping in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt
findings.summary: Dubai's Creators HQ and YouTube have launched a regional programme to train more than 1,000 creators across the Middle East and North Africa over the next two years through YouTube Academy masterclasses, so they can earn commission by tagging products in their videos. The YouTube Shopping affiliate programme is open to eligible creators in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt, with Amazon as its first affiliate partner and more merchants expected; it uses Google AI to identify products in videos and suggest tags, and viewers watching on television can buy by scanning an on-screen QR code. A YouTube Shopping experience will feature at the 1 Billion Followers Summit in Dubai on 8 to 10 January 2027.
findings.why: AI-assisted creator commerce is opening a sales channel in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt that retailers and mall brands can join as merchants.

findings.title: JLL: Dubai's new retail leases fell 7.3% year on year in Q3 while Abu Dhabi renewals rose 4.7%
findings.summary: JLL's UAE Retail Market Dynamics for Q3 2026, dated 5 Nov, says Abu Dhabi lease renewals rose 4.7% year on year and 15.5% on the quarter. In Dubai, new contracts fell 7.3% year on year but rose 7.2% on the quarter, while a 13.4% quarterly drop in renewals pulled total volumes lower. JLL says Q3 footfall was supported by resident demand and that landlords held their rental positions; the page gives no rent, supply or occupancy figures, and the PDF it links is still the Q2 report.
findings.why: Leasing volumes add a demand-side signal to CBRE's Q3 occupancy figures for UAE malls (see 9 Nov) ahead of the 2027 Directory's market pages.

findings.company: Total CX (Beyon Group); Al Salam Bank
findings.title: Total CX and Al Salam Bank sign an MoU to explore AI-powered customer service
findings.summary: Total CX, a Bahraini customer-experience and digital engagement provider that is part of the Beyon Group, and Al Salam Bank signed a memorandum of understanding at Gateway Gulf 2026 at the Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay to explore AI-powered customer experience solutions across the bank's customer engagement channels, News of Bahrain reported on 3 Nov. The work would cover customer interactions across voice, text and other digital channels. No pilot, timeline or financial terms were given.
findings.why: Total CX, which already runs AI service for Seef Properties' malls (see 28 Oct), is taking voice and chat AI into Bahraini banking, a benchmark for the service standards MECSC tracks.

No owner source gives the 130,000 sqm on the card.

findings.company: Red Sea Markets Company (Red Sea Market; SEDCO Holding Group)
findings.title: The Point in Abha was launched with 50,000 sqm of leasing area, not the 40,000 sqm GLA printed, and has no published opening date
findings.summary: Retail ME reported on 20 May 2023 that the foundation stone of The Point in Abha had been laid by Prince Turki bin Talal, Prince of the Asir region and Chairman of the Asir Development Authority, for Red Sea Markets Company, part of SEDCO Holding Group. The project has a land area of 750,000 sqm, building areas of 150,000 sqm and a leasing area of 50,000 sqm, with 150 stores, 10 cinemas, a 6,000 sqm hypermarket and a 150-room hotel under Hilton brands; no opening date was given. The directory prints The Point as upcoming with 40,000 sqm of GLA, a 2026 opening and RASM as developer.
findings.why: Corrects the size and developer of a member's pipeline listing and flags an opening year that no owner source supports.

findings.title: Golden Gate in New Cairo appears twice in the directory, with two sizes that its developer does not publish
findings.summary: The directory carries two cards for Golden Gate: one in Cairo (70,000 sqm GLA, opening 2024, owner REDCON) and one with no country or city (200,000 sqm, September 2026, owner Redcon Properties). The developer's groundbreaking release of February 2022 describes one mixed-use scheme of retail, offices and entertainment in New Cairo spanning 160,000 square metres (basis not stated), with phase one due by Q1 2024 and both phases within seven years. A later, undated release from REDCON Properties, the development arm of REDCON Group, says the handover of the first phase to clients had begun and that it planned to inaugurate the first phase by the third quarter of 2025; neither release gives a GLA.
findings.why: Merges a duplicate listing and removes two unsupported sizes before the Egypt pages print.

sources.outlet: ROCC press release (Zawya, undated; reported by Daily News Egypt on 2 Feb 2022)
REDCON Properties press release (Zawya, undated, refers to 2024 sales and 2025 plans; read 13 Nov 2026)

findings.title: A directory card titled 'Upcoming 12 downtown mix use projects' is a placeholder for Saudi Downtown Company's programme, not a mall
